fusions.name: Quad Splash
fusions.desc: Flicks 4 jets of water in a spread, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Murk Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a gout of dark water that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip Away
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloud Cover
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
